text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. One of its main tasks is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another important function is object detection, where the system not only recognizes objects but also finds their exact location in the image. These technologies have many practical applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision helps the vehicle detect pedestrians, traffic lights, and other cars, allowing it to make safe decisions on the road. From smartphone face unlock to medical scans, this technology is changing how we interact with the world.
